slides.title: Physician ki 4 qualities
slides.quote: …freedom from prejudice and sound senses, attention in observing and fidelity…

slides.title: Suno, roko mat
slides.quote: Keeping silence himself… refrains from interrupting them…
points: Chup raho, roko sirf topic bhatke to

slides.title: Har symptom, nayi line
slides.quote: He begins a fresh line with every new circumstance…

slides.title: Har symptom complete karo
slides.quote: …about each of them he inquires for further particulars…

slides.title: Leading questions nahi
slides.quote: …without ever framing his questions so as to suggest the answer…

slides.title: Jo chhoota, general sawaal
slides.quote: …he only makes use of general expressions…

slides.title: Phir special sawaal
slides.quote: …to ask more precise, more special questions.

slides.title: Doctor ka apna observation
slides.quote: …he then makes a note of what he himself observes in the patient…
